description: One Hyperliquid vault by address, by `view`. `profile`: TVL, APR, leverage, leader and top-5 shares, active depositors and all five windows (7d, 30d, 90d, 365d, all). `depositors`: every current depositor (not only the largest 100) with equity, PnL on the current position, all-time PnL, entry time, lockup end and PnL rank. `flows`: the vault's own ledger rows, newest first. `series`: equity, chained share price (`nav`), net flow and PnL per hour or day, oldest first (for a parent vault, its whole family). Its fills, trades and positions: hl_wallet and hl_wallet_activity with the vault address. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/vaults/{vault} and its sub-routes.

bucket.description: Point width: `1h` or `1d`. Used by view: series.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Used by view: depositors, flows, series.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Used by view: series.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default by view: depositors 100, flows 100, series 500. Max by view: depositors 1000, flows 1000, series 5000. Used by view: depositors, flows, series.

min_equity_usd.description: Smallest depositor equity in USD, at least 1. Used by view: depositors.

smart_only.description: Only depositors in the top 1,000 of the all-time PnL leaderboard. Used by view: depositors.

sort.description: Ranking: `share`, `pnl` (on the current position), `all_time_pnl` (since the first deposit) or `entered` (entry time). Used by view: depositors.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Used by view: series.

vault.description: Vault address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Required.

view.description: What to read. `profile`: TVL, APR, leverage, depositor concentration and all five windows. `depositors`: current depositors with their equity, PnL, entry and lockup, largest share first. `flows`: the vault's own deposits, withdrawals, distributions and commissions, newest first. `series`: equity, share price, net flow and PnL per hour or day, oldest first. Default `profile`.

window.description: Window ending on the newest recorded day: `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` or `all`. Used by view: flows.

name: hl_vault
title: Hyperliquid Vault
